none: PAS NLM-4F9EC6: Roman Coin: Commemorative Radiate of Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate of Claudius II (268-270), probably posthumous issue of 270, Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: [--]CLAVDIO. Reverse description: Aequitas standing left holding balance and cornucopiae. Reverse inscription: AEQVITA[--]. Diameter: 18.5mm, Weight: 2.94gms, die axis: 12
